purpose: Four UV-selected daytime cumulus sprites, used in world.js with a procedural fallback.
prompt: Create a production-quality photoreal cloud sprite atlas for a real-time civil flight simulator, a square 2048 x 2048 PNG with true transparent alpha background. Four clearly separated isolated cumulus clouds arranged in a precise 2 by 2 grid, each cloud centered inside its own quadrant and fully contained with at least 12 percent empty transparent padding on all edges of its quadrant. All four clouds are viewed from horizontal pilot height against no sky. Each cloud is a different naturally irregular, wide cumulus humilis or cumulus mediocris silhouette, with small-scale billowing edge detail, wispy partly transparent strands, and a gently flattened grey-blue base. Cloud width about 1.7 times height. Realistic midday daylight from upper-left/front, warm ivory highlights facing the sun, soft neutral slate-grey blue shadows on underside and far side, physically plausible soft multiple scattering inside cloud, natural photographic detail. Pale and subtle, NOT grey storm clouds. Consistent light direction and exposure across all four quadrants. No ground, no sky gradient, no horizon, no scenery, no sun disc, no text, no frame, no grid lines, no contact shadows. Isolated cloud sprites only. Avoid evenly spaced balls, cartoon cotton puffs, painted clouds or solid white cutouts. Alpha edges must be soft and believable. Purpose: four UV-selected cloud textures for large outdoor 3D cloud planes; realistic silhouetted volume should hold up from a pilot's cockpit.
editPrompt: Fix the layout of this transparent four-cloud sprite atlas. Keep the photographic realism and same sunlight, but each of the four clouds must be a fully isolated complete silhouette. Arrange the four clouds exactly at centers of the four quadrants of a square 2x2 grid. Scale EACH cloud down to 72 percent of its current width and height so every quadrant has generous invisible transparent padding all around, and there is a broad clear transparent gap between all four clouds and around the outside edges. No two clouds touch and no cloud touches the outer canvas boundary. Preserve softly feathered alpha edges and wispy strands. Remove any colored edge contamination (blue or cyan fringe). Each cloud: sunlit ivory and neutral blue-grey underside, daytime photographic cumulus, no sky or scenery or text. Full cloud sprites are contained individually in their quadrant, transparent outside.
